description: This file defines the ICapture interface and its nested IStore interface within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace. It provides method signatures for screenshot capturing capabilities, including storing image buffers, retrieving interface name, and obtaining an ICapture instance. The file includes licensing information and external module dependencies.

classes.name: ICapture
classes.description: An interface for capturing screenshots or screen data, providing methods to get interface name and perform capture operations, along with a static method to obtain an instance.

classes.name: ICapture::IStore
classes.description: A nested interface for storing image data, with method to store RGBA data given image buffer and dimensions.

methods.name: ICapture::Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the capture interface.

methods.name: ICapture::Capture
methods.description: Performs a screen capture and stores the result using the provided IStore instance.

methods.name: ICapture::Instance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the ICapture interface.

ctags.name: ICapture
ctags.pattern: /^    struct EXTERNAL ICapture : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/
